lead: Kalpana Chawla was an Indian military flight engineer, born on 17 March 1962 in Karnal.
She died on 1 February 2003 in Texas at the age of 40.
She has been recognised with Congressional Space Medal of Honor and Order of Merit (Ukraine), 3rd class.
This profile collects the Kalpana facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Kalpana Chawla — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Kalpana Chawla was born on 17 March 1962 in Karnal, and holds Indian and American nationality.

paras: Kalpana Chawla works primarily as a military flight engineer, astronaut and amateur radio operator, with National Aeronautics and Space Administration, Ames Research Center and Overset Methods, Inc. listed among her employers.
